description: Ministry of Justice and Prison Reforms - Special Mediation (Qualifications of Mediators) Regulation No. 1 of 2019
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Justice and Prison Reforms under the Mediation (Special Categories of Disputes) Act, establishing qualifications for mediators. It constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory framework matters, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure changes.
